        13                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator

        14       Huntley, Legislative Resolution Number 1628,

        15       memorializing Governor David A. Paterson to

        16       proclaim May 4, 2009, as Your Story Matters

        17       Day in the State of New York.

        18                  ACTING PRESIDENT VALESKY:

        19       Senator Huntley, on the resolution.

        20                  SENATOR HUNTLEY:    Yes,

        21       Mr. President.

        22                  The resolution to me was fitting

        23       because a number of people who have had issues

        24       with drugs, people who are fighting their way



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                         3809



         1       back to society, I think they all deserve a

         2       chance to do that.

         3                  I think this resolution gives them

         4       what they need in order to become good

         5       citizens, in order to maintain decent

         6       employment, and to know that people care about

         7       their issues.  And as long as we do, perhaps

         8       they will all come back into the American

         9       dream kind of concept and move on to have

        10       better lives.

        11                  So based on that, I would like to

        12       just wish them well.  And I think we all

        13       should, because we talk about maintaining good

        14       citizens in this country, people who are

        15       viable, people who maintain good employment.

        16       And all it does is make the country better.

        17       And I commend them for their fight.

        18                  Thank you.

        21       Mr. President.

        22                  I just want to thank my colleagues

        23       for supporting this bill.  I think many of you

        24       figured that "I Love New York" already was the



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       official state slogan, but it actually wasn't.

         2                  So I think this bill is important

         3       because it will codify the slogan "I Love

         4       New York."  It has no fiscal impact.  But I

         5       think the benefit of further branding "I Love

         6       New York" is that it helps in our tourism

         7       efforts, it helps on other issues that involve

         8       having a state slogan.  For instance, when we

         9       had our state quarter, we didn't have a slogan

        10       to put on it because we didn't have an

        11       official state slogan.

        12                  But anyhow, I think that this is a

        13       wonderful tourism tool, and I thank my

        14       colleagues for supporting this legislation.
